_rules: A person appears on the public site only when publish=true. publish=true needs: relationship confirmed by Kevan, public facts sourced, and the person's own yes recorded in 'yes' (who, date, how). Photos need the same yes from everyone identifiable in them, and a parent's written yes for anyone under 18 in the frame. Role lines state history, never endorsement.

people.name: John Mayotte
people.relationship: Kevan's college coach at Troy. Years later, when Kevan was director of baseball at Montverde Academy, he hired Coach Mayotte as head coach for the season; he and his wife lived on campus.
people.notes: Kevan gave his wife's first name in chat (2026-10-26); use it on the page only with her yes.
people.public_facts: Troy head coach 1991-2002; led Troy to the 1993 NCAA Division II College World Series; 386 wins at Troy. Died January 2022.
people.open: Kevan's years at Troy; family's yes for an in-memory mention
